atoms.text: The pitch the note refers to depends on where the note is written on the lines, and which clef is written at the beginning of the stave.

instruction.text: Select each note one by one, beginning with the lowest note.

atoms.title: What kinds of notes are there?

atoms.text: Notes can look very different to one another:
Some notes have an empty notehead and some noteheads are filled in. Most notes have a stem and some also have a flag.
atoms.sound: Some notes have an empty notehead and some noteheads are filled in. Most notes have a stem and some also have a flag.

atoms.a: What are the different parts of a musical note?

atoms.text: How a note looks determines its note value. The note value refers to how long you play a note, also known as its duration. The most common notes are semibreves, minims, crotchets and quavers.
atoms.sound: How a note looks determines its note value. The note value refers to how long you play a note, also known as its duration. The most common notes are semibreves, minims, crotchets, and quavers.

instruction.text: Choose the note that fits the description.

atoms.a: Semibreves have no stem and are hollow.
Minims have a stem and are hollow.
Crotchets have a stem and are solid.
Quavers have a stem with a flag and are solid.
